items.t: CXAI Expands Agentic AI Reach into Mid-Market Through EngineRoom's Simpro Partnership
items.sum: EngineRoom, powered by CXAI, showcased its AI-powered growth intelligence platform at Simprosium Sydney 2026, held November 9-10, at an event that drew more than 750 Simpro customers. EngineRoom extends the Company's AI capabilities into customer acquisition and revenue growth for mid-market businesses.
